title: Batman 2 Clues: Two-Face and the Court of Owls?
summary:
A new Batman movie, "The Batman Part II," is being filmed now. Steven Soderbergh is helping as director while Matt Reeves deals with a family crisis. No one knows yet who the new actors will play.

For a long time, fans thought Sebastian Stan would play Harvey Dent, also called Two-Face. But a reporter named Jeff Sneider said in June that Brian Tyree Henry would play Dent instead. He said Stan would play Victor Zsasz, a dangerous villain.

Fans may have found clues. Heidi Klum is famous for big Halloween costumes. Mike Marino, who makes her costumes, also worked on "The Batman" and is back for "Part II." Fans saw what look like props from the new movie in a video about Klum's costume. There was something like a cast of Henry's face with a hurt lip, which points to Two-Face. There was also a box marked "Zsasz" and a box marked "Owl 3."

"Owl 3" may mean the Court of Owls. In the comics, this secret group has controlled Gotham City from the shadows for hundreds of years. Its members wear owl masks. They send out fighters called Talons. The Owls were made in 2011 by Scott Snyder and Greg Capullo. Many fans have long wanted them as villains in a sequel. "The Batman Part II" is set to come out on February 18, 2028.
why_it_matters: Guessing a movie's secrets from clues is a fun way to enjoy a story before it comes out.
